instructions.zh: 在 Steam 库中右键点击鬼武者 剑之道，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Right-click Onimusha: Way of the Sword in your Steam library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 在游戏文件夹中选中 re2_framework_log.txt，拖入日志上传区域。
instructions.en: Select re2_framework_log.txt in the game folder and drag it into the log upload area.

instructions.zh: 在游戏文件夹中选中 re2_fw_config.txt，拖入日志上传区域。（只有作者要求时才需要上传）
instructions.en: Select re2_fw_config.txt in the game folder and drag it into the log upload area. (Only upload if the author requests it)

instructions.zh: 在游戏文件夹中选中 reframework_crash.dmp，拖入日志上传区域。（只有作者要求时才需要上传）
instructions.en: Select reframework_crash.dmp in the game folder and drag it into the log upload area. (Only upload if the author requests it)
